|game_text=May be stacked on [[I Know That Laugh]] from hand, using 2 Force. While stacked on I Know That Laugh, stack face-up and during any battle may draw destiny. If destiny < number of your aliens in battle, reset a participating character's forfeit to 0.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text; the images are the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p4-76-Rennek.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-rennek-pre.gif]]). The later errata version is [[Rennek (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet (official text as of 14 September 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 14, 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 October 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022233130/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “May be stacked on I Know That Laugh from hand, using 2 Force. While stacked on I Know That Laugh, stack face-up and during any battle may draw destiny. If destiny < number of your aliens in battle, reset a participating character's forfeit to 0.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p4-76-Rennek.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-rennek-pre.gif]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 14) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Rennek (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 12 December 2012 and in the capture of 11 January 2013) changed “from hand, using 2 Force” to “from hand for 2 force” and “reset” to “reduce”<ref name="cl-1282_19-2012-12-12">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive); the same text in the capture of 11 January 2013 (the card is not in the capture of 21 July 2012, before Virtual Block 8.2)</ref>: “May be stacked on I Know That Laugh from hand for 2 force. While stacked on I Know That Laugh, stack face-up and during any battle may draw destiny. If destiny < number of your aliens in battle, reduce a participating character's forfeit to 0.” No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-p4-76-Rennek-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
